description:
Motivation: We see recurring incidents where prompt-set regressions surface only after a delayed customer rollout or after a time-lag (e.g., versioned prompts combined with partial rollouts). Existing CI smokechecks are good for immediate regressions but insufficient for detecting instability that emerges due to temporal ordering or stale anchor snapshots. This PR introduces a Prompt Lifecycle Sentinel prober and a lag-adaptive holdback gate for CI that together detect and mitigate temporal/regression modes before they reach production.

What this change does: Adds a new prober (eval-harness/probers/prompt_lifecycle_sentinel.py) that captures lightweight anchor snapshots (prompt version, rollout_id, sample seeds), replays a synthesized user-feedback stream using a replay client, and emits time-windowed stability metrics (windowed delta, cohort variance, slowness score). Introduces a CI hook (eval-harness/ci/hooks/lag_adaptive_gate.yaml) that integrates with the eval orchestration to run the sentinel as part of pre-merge checks or nightly regression sweeps. The gate implements progressive quarantine: on the first failure we mark the PR with a soft-hold that requires triage and a follow-up comparative run; repeated failures within a short window escalate to a hard holdback. The gate uses configurable thresholds and min-volume guards to avoid noisy false positives.

Implementation notes: - Snapshot format is intentionally compact and stored in the artifact cache; snapshots include prompt_set id, compacted prompt fingerprint, rollout_id, and a monotonic timestamp. - Replay client is best-effort and rate-limited to avoid burdening serving; tests include a local in-memory stub. - Metrics are emitted via prompt_metrics emitter with tags [prompt_set, rollout_id, seed] and coarse timestamping. - The orchestration wiring adds a non-blocking shadow run path so the sentinel can run during long CI windows and still surface results in PRs without blocking unrelated work. - Added an integration smoke test that simulates a staggered rollout and asserts the gate's holdback transition logic.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests added under tests/probers/*. Integration smoke runs executed in the eval staging environment. CI required one rerun due to a flaky tokenization edge-case in an unrelated test; rerun succeeded. We plan a canary rollout of the gate for the next two weeks: run as soft-hold on main CI, emit dashboards and annotate regression incidents. After monitoring for false positives we will flip to hard-enforce for high-impact prompt_set tags.

Related work: EN G-2134 tracks the prompt rollouts and visibility work; ENG-2207 requested more deterministic replay behavior and was used to justify the replay client changes. Links: internal/linear/ENG-2134, internal/linear/ENG-2207.
